findings.title: Light, fire, and brand at the exposed recipient
findings.claim: The dust-bound needy person is placed in a local field where fire can be both a settling hearth and a visible, contacting mark, so the recipient's condition becomes an exposed human presence rather than only an abstract need.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence of miskinan activates the supplied hearth-like facet when the later fire occurrence in 90:20 provides an independent contact; that same fire carries the nominated illumination and branding images, making the focus condition visible and touchable in the local sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The recipient can be perceived as a person whose need calls for humane warmth and whose exposure is brought into view and contact by the closing fire image.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-local contextual resonance. It does not make miskin mean fire, does not add illumination or branding as the lexical meaning of the focus phrase, and does not establish a surah-wide channel. The fire may also remain the independent literal closing image.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel supports and exact focus/context surface contact are supplied, while the synthesis connecting visibility and marking back to the focus is an attributed contextual inference.
